--!strict

-- B mixes the original imported green plant with three authored FBX shapes.
-- Both bounded renderers use the same deterministic geometry, size and anchor.
local Geometry = require(script.Parent.CornGreenGeometry)
local detailedTemplates = nil
local detailedBuilding = false
local templateSizes = nil
local templateContents = nil
local SOURCE_SHA256 = "259fbe167d4c0a24e6813282a5f3026d582b67d7af1f701bad39bed706a193df"
local EXPECTED_SIZE = Vector3.new(3.0026558642674086, 8, 3.1309012101883917)
local OPTIONS = {
	CollisionFidelity = Enum.CollisionFidelity.Box,
	RenderFidelity = Enum.RenderFidelity.Precise,
}
local CornAppearance = {
	MeshId = "rbxassetid://104111861186519",
	GreenTextureId = "rbxassetid://137803536172445",
	-- CornField.Prepare uses this legacy property before art can replicate.
	-- Its B value deliberately stays green in every menu and round mode.
	DryTextureId = "rbxassetid://137803536172445",
	DetailedNearChunkLimit = 8,
	DetailedNearPlantLimit = 1152,
	DetailedHeight = 8,
}

local originalDescription = table.freeze({
	size = EXPECTED_SIZE,
	rootOffset = Vector3.new(0, 4, 0),
	sourceHash = SOURCE_SHA256,
})
local function description(variety)
	if variety == 1 then
		return originalDescription
	end
	return Geometry.Describe(string.format("Var%02d", variety - 1))
end

function CornAppearance.Variety(column: number, row: number): number
	return ((column * 73856093 + row * 19349663 + 817) % 104729) % 4 + 1
end

function CornAppearance.IsDetailedMap(map: Instance?): boolean
	return map ~= nil
		and map:IsA("Model")
		and map.Name == "CornMap"
		and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		and map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
end

function CornAppearance.DetailedKey(variety: number, lod: string): string
	assert(variety >= 1 and variety <= 4 and variety % 1 == 0, "Corn variety must be 1..4")
	assert(lod == "Near" or lod == "Mid" or lod == "Far", "Unknown corn geometry LOD")
	return "Corn_" .. string.char(64 + variety) .. "_" .. lod
end

local function attributes(variety: number, lod: string): { [string]: any }
	local data = description(variety)
	return {
		corn_project_id = "children_of_corn",
		CornPlantTemplateOwned = true,
		CornGreenOriginal = true,
		CornGreenTemplateOwned = true,
		CornGreenTemplateVersion = 2,
		CornGreenSourceSHA256 = data.sourceHash,
		CornGreenVariety = variety,
		CornGreenLod = lod,
		HarvestRootOffset = data.rootOffset,
		CornGreenTemplateSize = data.size,
	}
end

function CornAppearance.IsDetailedPlant(part: Instance, variety: number, lod: string): boolean
	CornAppearance.DetailedKey(variety, lod)
	local data = description(variety)
	return part:IsA("MeshPart")
		and part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		and part:GetAttribute("CornGreenOriginal") == true
		and part:GetAttribute("CornGreenTemplateOwned") == true
		and part:GetAttribute("CornGreenTemplateVersion") == 2
		and part:GetAttribute("CornGreenSourceSHA256") == data.sourceHash
		and part:GetAttribute("CornGreenVariety") == variety
		and part:GetAttribute("CornGreenLod") == lod
		and (if variety == 1
			then part.MeshId == CornAppearance.MeshId
				and part.MeshContent.SourceType == Enum.ContentSourceType.Uri
			else part.MeshContent.SourceType == Enum.ContentSourceType.Opaque)
		and part.TextureID == CornAppearance.GreenTextureId
		and part.Anchored
		and part.Archivable
		and not part.CanCollide
		and not part.CanTouch
		and not part.CanQuery
end

function CornAppearance.DetailedPivot(plant: BasePart, position: Vector3, yaw: number): CFrame
	assert(
		plant:IsA("MeshPart")
			and plant:GetAttribute("CornGreenOriginal") == true
			and plant:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn",
		"Original green corn root binding required"
	)
	local offset, size =
		plant:GetAttribute("HarvestRootOffset"), plant:GetAttribute("CornGreenTemplateSize")
	assert(
		typeof(offset) == "Vector3"
			and typeof(size) == "Vector3"
			and size.X > 0
			and size.Y > 0
			and size.Z > 0,
		"Authored corn anchor required"
	)
	local scaled = Vector3.new(
		offset.X * plant.Size.X / size.X,
		offset.Y * plant.Size.Y / size.Y,
		offset.Z * plant.Size.Z / size.Z
	)
	return CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.new(scaled)
end

local function validateTemplate(
	part: MeshPart,
	variety: number,
	lod: string,
	size: Vector3,
	content: Content
)
	assert(
		CornAppearance.IsDetailedPlant(part, variety, lod)
			and part.Parent == nil
			and part.Name == CornAppearance.DetailedKey(variety, lod)
			and part.CFrame == CFrame.identity
			and part.PivotOffset == CFrame.identity
			and part.Size == size
			and part.MeshContent == content
			and part.CastShadow
			and part.DoubleSided
			and part.Transparency == 0
			and part.Reflectance == 0
			and part.Color == Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			and part.Material == Enum.Material.Plastic
			and part.MaterialVariant == ""
			and part.Massless
			and part.CollisionGroup == "Default"
			and part.CustomPhysicalProperties == nil
			and part.CollisionFidelity == OPTIONS.CollisionFidelity
			and part.RenderFidelity == OPTIONS.RenderFidelity
			and #part:GetChildren() == 0
			and #part:GetTags() == 0,
		"Private B green corn template was changed; author work preserved"
	)
	local expected = attributes(variety, lod)
	local actual = part:GetAttributes()
	for key, value in expected do
		assert(actual[key] == value, "Private B green corn attribute changed: " .. key)
	end
	for key in actual do
		assert(expected[key] ~= nil, "Foreign private B green corn attribute: " .. key)
	end
end

local function validateCache(cache, sizes, contents)
	local seen: { [Instance]: boolean } = {}
	for _, lod in { "Near", "Mid", "Far" } do
		for variety = 1, 4 do
			local part = cache[lod][variety]
			assert(not seen[part], "Duplicate private B green corn template")
			seen[part] = true
			validateTemplate(part, variety, lod, sizes[variety], contents[variety])
		end
	end
end

local function decorate(part: MeshPart, variety: number, lod: string, size: Vector3)
	part.Name = CornAppearance.DetailedKey(variety, lod)
	part.Archivable = true
	part.CFrame = CFrame.identity
	part.PivotOffset = CFrame.identity
	part.Size = size
	part.TextureID = CornAppearance.GreenTextureId
	part.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	part.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
	part.MaterialVariant = ""
	part.Transparency = 0
	part.Reflectance = 0
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.CastShadow = true
	part.DoubleSided = true
	part.Massless = true
	part.CollisionGroup = "Default"
	part.CustomPhysicalProperties = nil
	for key, value in attributes(variety, lod) do
		part:SetAttribute(key, value)
	end
end

function CornAppearance.DetailedTemplates(): any
	while detailedBuilding do
		task.wait()
	end
	if detailedTemplates then
		validateCache(detailedTemplates, templateSizes, templateContents)
		return detailedTemplates
	end
	detailedBuilding = true
	local created: { MeshPart } = {}
	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local assetService = game:GetService("AssetService")
		local original = assert(
			assetService:CreateMeshPartAsync(Content.fromUri(CornAppearance.MeshId), OPTIONS),
			"Original green corn mesh unavailable"
		)
		table.insert(created, original)
		assert(
			original:IsA("MeshPart")
				and original.Parent == nil
				and original.MeshContent.SourceType == Enum.ContentSourceType.Uri
				and original.MeshId == CornAppearance.MeshId
				and original.MeshSize.Y > 0
				and #original:GetChildren() == 0
				and #original:GetTags() == 0
				and next(original:GetAttributes()) == nil,
			"Original green corn asset binding changed"
		)
		local size = original.MeshSize * (CornAppearance.DetailedHeight / original.MeshSize.Y)
		assert((size - EXPECTED_SIZE).Magnitude < 0.003, "Original green corn FBX bounds differ")
		local templates = { Near = {}, Mid = {}, Far = {} }
		local bases = { original }
		local sizes = { size }
		local contents = { original.MeshContent }
		for variety = 2, 4 do
			local part, data = Geometry.Bake(string.format("Var%02d", variety - 1))
			table.insert(created, part)
			bases[variety] = part
			sizes[variety] = data.size
			contents[variety] = part.MeshContent
		end
		for _, lod in { "Near", "Mid", "Far" } do
			for variety = 1, 4 do
				local part = bases[variety]
				if lod ~= "Near" then
					part = assert(bases[variety]:Clone(), "Green corn private clone unavailable")
					table.insert(created, part)
				end
				decorate(part, variety, lod, sizes[variety])
				templates[lod][variety] = part
			end
			table.freeze(templates[lod])
		end
		validateCache(templates, sizes, contents)
		templateSizes = sizes
		templateContents = contents
		return table.freeze(templates)
	end)
	detailedBuilding = false
	if not ok then
		for _, part in created do
			part:Destroy()
		end
		error("B green corn unavailable; a later call can retry: " .. tostring(result), 0)
	end
	detailedTemplates = result
	return result
end

function CornAppearance.IsDry(_mode: string?): boolean
	return false
end

function CornAppearance.IsValidMode(mode: any): boolean
	return mode == nil or mode == "easy" or mode == "medium" or mode == "hard"
end

return table.freeze(CornAppearance)

	Height = 8,
	Spacing = 3,
	Seed = 817,
	ChunkCells = 12,
	RenderRadius = 150,
	ElevatedRadius = 200,
	DenseRadius = 60,
	MediumRadius = 130,
}

export type Box = { Frame: CFrame, HalfSize: Vector2 }
export type Circle = { Center: Vector3, Radius: number }
export type TrailEdge = {
	CenterX: number,
	CenterZ: number,
	HalfWidth: number,
	HalfLength: number,
	AlongX: boolean,
	Key: string,
}
export type Exclusions = {
	Boxes: { Box },
	Circles: { Circle },
	Signature: string,
	TrailEdges: { TrailEdge }?,
	TrailEdgeMaxShift: number?,
	GreenBeds: boolean?,
}

local BOX_PADDING = 1.5

-- removing hashed individual cells and leaving irregular holes in each row.

local GREEN_TRAIL_EDGE_OUTSET = 0.15

		and map.Name == "CornMap"
		and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		and map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"

function CornLayout.PivotForPlant(plant: Plant, groundPosition: Vector3, yaw: number): CFrame
	local bounds, size = CornLayout.Bounds(plant)
	local boundsFromPivot = plant:GetPivot():ToObjectSpace(bounds)
	return CFrame.new(groundPosition + Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2, 0))
		* CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
		* boundsFromPivot:Inverse()
end

function CornLayout.SpacingFor(field: BasePart): number
	local map = field.Parent
	if
		field.Name == "FieldZone"
		and map
		and map:IsA("Model")
		and map.Name == "CornMap"
		and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
		and map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
	then
		return CornLayout.Spacing * DETAILED_SPACING_SCALE
	end

function CornLayout.GetCellBounds(field: BasePart): (number, number, number, number)
	local half = field.Size / 2
	local spacing = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field)
	return math.ceil(-half.X / spacing),
		math.floor(half.X / spacing),
		math.ceil(-half.Z / spacing),
		math.floor(half.Z / spacing)
end

function CornLayout.BaseCellPosition(field: BasePart, column: number, row: number): Vector3
	local half = field.Size / 2
	local spacing = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field)
	if greenField(field) then
		return field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(column * spacing, -half.Y, row * spacing))
	end

		Vector3.new(math.clamp(x, -half.X, half.X), -half.Y, math.clamp(z, -half.Z, half.Z))
	)

	return ((column * 73856093 + row * 19349663 + CornLayout.Seed * salt) % 104729) / 104729

function CornLayout.CellPosition(field: BasePart, column: number, row: number): Vector3
	if greenField(field) then
		return GreenBedLayout.Position(CornLayout.BaseCellPosition(field, column, row))
	end
	local point = field.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(CornLayout.BaseCellPosition(field, column, row))
	local half = field.Size / 2
	local spacing = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field)
	return field.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(
		Vector3.new(
			math.clamp(point.X + (hash(column, row, 17) * 2 - 1) * spacing * 0.1, -half.X, half.X),
			point.Y,
			math.clamp(point.Z + (hash(column, row, 31) * 2 - 1) * spacing * 0.1, -half.Z, half.Z)
		)
	)
end

	return 0.85 + hash(column, row, 97) * 0.3

	if plant:GetAttribute("CornGreenOriginal") == true then
		-- All four green geometry templates start at height eight. Scale only Y;
		-- DetailedPivot subsequently uses their real root anchor and this Size.
		local factor = CornLayout.HeightFactor(column, row)
		assert(plant:IsA("BasePart"), "B green height variation requires a single static part")
		plant.Size = Vector3.new(plant.Size.X, plant.Size.Y * factor, plant.Size.Z)

	end

		plant.Size = Vector3.new(plant.Size.X, plant.Size.Y * factor, plant.Size.Z)
	else
		plant:ScaleTo(plant:GetScale() * factor)
	end
end

local function footprint(frame: CFrame, size: Vector3, padding: number): Box
	local look = frame.LookVector
	local yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
	local flat = CFrame.new(frame.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
	local half = size / 2
	local right = flat.RightVector
	local forward = flat.LookVector
	local width = math.abs(right:Dot(frame.RightVector)) * half.X
		+ math.abs(right:Dot(frame.UpVector)) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(right:Dot(frame.LookVector)) * half.Z
	local depth = math.abs(forward:Dot(frame.RightVector)) * half.X
		+ math.abs(forward:Dot(frame.UpVector)) * half.Y
		+ math.abs(forward:Dot(frame.LookVector)) * half.Z
	return { Frame = flat, HalfSize = Vector2.new(width + padding, depth + padding) }

			and part.Parent == maze
			and part:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == "children_of_corn"
			and part:GetAttribute("CornMazeOwner") == "corn_maze02_v1"

			local center = part.CFrame.Position

				CenterX = center.X,
				CenterZ = center.Z,
				HalfWidth = math.min(part.Size.X, part.Size.Z) / 2,
				HalfLength = math.max(part.Size.X, part.Size.Z) / 2,
				AlongX = part.Size.X > part.Size.Z,
				Key = part.Name,
			})
		end
		table.insert(
			signatures,
			part:GetFullName()
				.. "/box/"
				.. tostring(part.CFrame)
				.. "/"
				.. tostring(part.Size)
				.. "/"
				.. padding
		)

		if item:IsA("BasePart") then
			if item:HasTag("corn_no_corn_zone") then
				addBox(item, BOX_PADDING)
			end
			if item:HasTag("corn_key_slot") then
				table.insert(circles, { Center = item.Position, Radius = SLOT_RADIUS })
				table.insert(signatures, item:GetFullName() .. "/slot/" .. tostring(item.Position))
			elseif item:HasTag("corn_spawn") then
				addBox(item, 4)
				table.insert(circles, { Center = item.Position, Radius = 10 })
				table.insert(signatures, item:GetFullName() .. "/spawn/" .. tostring(item.Position))
			end
		end
	end
	local gate = map:FindFirstChild("EscapeGate")
	if gate then
		local door = gate:FindFirstChild("Door", true)
		if door and door:IsA("BasePart") then
			addBox(door, 6)
		end
	end
	table.sort(signatures)
	table.sort(trailEdges, function(a, b)
		return a.Key < b.Key
	end)
	local signature = table.concat(signatures, "|")
	local green = greenField(field)
	if green then
		local matches = signature == GreenBedLayout.Signature
		if not matches and game:GetService("RunService"):IsClient() then
			matches = GreenBedLayout.MatchesExclusions({ Boxes = boxes, Circles = circles }, field)
		end
		assert(matches, "B clearances changed; regenerate the guarded green-bed plan")
		-- A stable accepted signature keeps normal network rounding from causing
		-- repeated renderer rebuilds. Exact Edit/server checks remain above.
		signature = GreenBedLayout.Signature
			.. "|green-beds-v2-density70/"
			.. GreenBedLayout.InputSHA256
	end
	return {
		Boxes = boxes,
		Circles = circles,
		Signature = signature,
		TrailEdges = trailEdges,
		TrailEdgeMaxShift = CornLayout.SpacingFor(field),
		GreenBeds = green,
	}
end

function CornLayout.IsExcluded(position: Vector3, exclusions: Exclusions): boolean
	if exclusions.GreenBeds and not GreenBedLayout.Contains(position) then
		return true
	end
	for _, circle in exclusions.Circles do
		local delta = position - circle.Center
		if delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z <= circle.Radius * circle.Radius then
			return true
		end
	end
	for _, box in exclusions.Boxes do
		local localPosition = box.Frame:PointToObjectSpace(position)
		if
			math.abs(localPosition.X) <= box.HalfSize.X
			and math.abs(localPosition.Z) <= box.HalfSize.Y
		then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function CornLayout.TrailEdgePosition(position: Vector3, exclusions: Exclusions): Vector3
	local edges = exclusions.TrailEdges
	local reach = exclusions.TrailEdgeMaxShift
	if not edges or #edges == 0 or not reach then
		return position
	end
	local bestGap = math.huge
	local x, z = position.X, position.Z
	local candidateX, candidateZ = x, z
	local found = false
	local outset = if exclusions.GreenBeds then GREEN_TRAIL_EDGE_OUTSET else TRAIL_EDGE_OUTSET
	for _, edge in edges do
		local dx, dz = x - edge.CenterX, z - edge.CenterZ
		local across = if edge.AlongX then dz else dx
		local along = if edge.AlongX then dx else dz
		local gap = math.abs(across) - edge.HalfWidth
		if
			gap >= (if exclusions.GreenBeds then outset else 0)
			and gap <= reach
			and gap < bestGap
			and math.abs(along) <= edge.HalfLength - 1
		then
			bestGap = gap
			local target = (if across < 0 then -1 else 1) * (edge.HalfWidth + outset)
			candidateX = if edge.AlongX then x else edge.CenterX + target
			candidateZ = if edge.AlongX then edge.CenterZ + target else z
			found = true
		end
	end
	-- Reuse existing cells, variants and render budgets. Both the original and
	-- projected root must pass every clearance, including crossing paths.
	local candidate = if found then Vector3.new(candidateX, position.Y, candidateZ) else nil
	if candidate and exclusions.GreenBeds then
		local height = GreenBedLayout.GetHeight(candidate)
		if not height then
			-- Rounded FBX skirts do not fill their bounding rectangles. Retain
			-- the closest real bed surface along this bounded, path-safe segment;
			-- never invent soil heights or add an extra plant at the trail edge.
			local valid, invalid = 0, 1
			local base = position
			local delta = candidate - base
			for _ = 1, 8 do
				local amount = (valid + invalid) / 2
				local sample = base + delta * amount
				local sampledHeight = GreenBedLayout.GetHeight(sample)
				if sampledHeight then
					valid, height = amount, sampledHeight
				else
					invalid = amount
				end
			end
			if valid == 0 then
				return position
			end
			candidate = base + delta * valid
		end
		assert(height, "Projected B corn root requires a real bed surface")
		candidate = Vector3.new(candidate.X, height, candidate.Z)
	end
	if
		candidate
		and not CornLayout.IsExcluded(position, exclusions)
		and not CornLayout.IsExcluded(candidate, exclusions)
	then
		return candidate
	end
	return position
end

return CornLayout

StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/GameC.source:
--!strict
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local CornWindController = { Name = "CornWindController", Order = 55 }
local PROJECT_ID = "children_of_corn"
local BUCKET_SIZE = 6
local RADIUS = 5
local MONSTER_VIEW_RADIUS = 70
local UPDATE_SEC = 1 / 12
local SELECT_SEC = 0.2
local RESOLVE_SEC = 0.5
local INDEX_BUDGET = 64
local INDEX_SECONDS = 0.001
local ACTOR_LIMIT = 2
local SCAN_LIMIT = 128
local PART_LIMIT = 32
local TRAIL_SEC = 0.3
local MAX_PARTS_PER_PLANT = 8
local ANGLE = math.rad(3)

local function disconnect(connections: { RBXScriptConnection })
	for _, connection in connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)
end

local function decorative(part: BasePart): boolean
	return part.Anchored and not part.CanCollide and not part.CanTouch and not part.CanQuery
end

local function bucketKey(x: number, z: number): string
	return tostring(x) .. ":" .. tostring(z)
end

function CornWindController:_ownedLayer(folder: Instance, kind: string): boolean
	return folder:IsA("Folder")
		and folder.Parent == self._map
		and folder:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
		and (
			if kind == "near"
				then folder.Name == "CornClientPlants" and folder:GetAttribute(
					"CornClientRendererOwned"
				) == true
				else folder.Name == "CornClientBackdrop" and folder:GetAttribute(
					"CornClientBackdropOwned"
				) == true and folder:GetAttribute("CornEditorOverview") == true
		)
end

function CornWindController:_validEntry(entry: any): boolean
	local layer = entry.Layer
	if
		self._layers[layer.Kind] ~= layer
		or not self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, layer.Kind)
		or entry.Plant.Parent ~= entry.Parent
	then
		return false
	end
	if layer.Kind == "near" then
		if
			entry.Parent.Parent ~= layer.Folder
			or entry.Plant.Name ~= "Corn"
			or entry.Plant:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
		then
			return false
		end
	elseif
		entry.Plant:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") ~= true
		or entry.Plant:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		return false
	end
	for _, saved in entry.Parts do
		if not decorative(saved.Part) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function CornWindController:_restore(entry: any)
	if not entry.Moved then
		return
	end
	-- Removed copies can still be unparented Instances. Restore their exact frames
	-- before forgetting them; destroyed copies need no recovery.
	for _, saved in entry.Parts do
		pcall(function()
			saved.Part.CFrame = saved.Frame
		end)
	end
	entry.Moved = false
end

function CornWindController:_restoreActive()
	for entry in self._active do
		self:_restore(entry)
	end
	self._active = {}
	self._selected = {}
end

function CornWindController:_remove(layer: any, plant: Instance)
	local entry = layer.Entries[plant]
	if not entry then
		return
	end
	self:_restore(entry)
	self._active[entry] = nil
	layer.Entries[plant] = nil
	layer.Count -= 1
	local bucket = layer.Buckets[entry.Bucket]
	if bucket then
		bucket[entry] = nil
		if next(bucket) == nil then
			layer.Buckets[entry.Bucket] = nil
		end
	end
	local group = layer.Groups[entry.Parent]
	if group then
		group.Entries[plant] = nil
	end
	self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_enqueue(layer: any, plant: Instance, parent: Instance)
	self._pendingTail += 1
	self._pending[self._pendingTail] = { Layer = layer, Plant = plant, Parent = parent }
end

function CornWindController:_register(job: any)
	local layer, plant, parent = job.Layer, job.Plant, job.Parent
	if
		self._layers[layer.Kind] ~= layer
		or layer.Entries[plant]
		or not self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, layer.Kind)
		or plant.Parent ~= parent
	then
		return
	end
	if layer.Kind == "near" then
		if
			not layer.Groups[parent]
			or plant.Name ~= "Corn"
			or plant:GetAttribute("CornPlantTemplateOwned") ~= true
		then
			return
		end
	elseif
		not plant.Name:match("^Far_%-?%d+_%-?%d+$")
		or plant:GetAttribute("CornClientBackdropOwned") ~= true
		or plant:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		return
	end
	local detailed = self._map:GetAttribute("HarvestArtVariant") == "B"
	local limit = if layer.Kind == "near"
		then (if detailed then 8192 else 4096)
		else (if detailed then 30000 else 20000)
	if layer.Count >= limit then
		return
	end
	local parts, frame, size = {}, nil, nil
	if plant:IsA("BasePart") then
		if not decorative(plant) then
			return
		end
		table.insert(parts, { Part = plant, Frame = plant.CFrame })
		frame, size = plant.CFrame, plant.Size
	elseif plant:IsA("Model") then
		for _, part in plant:GetDescendants() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				if not decorative(part) or #parts >= MAX_PARTS_PER_PLANT then
					return
				end
				table.insert(parts, { Part = part, Frame = part.CFrame })
			end
		end
		if #parts == 0 then
			return
		end
		frame, size = plant:GetBoundingBox()
	else
		return
	end
	local position = frame.Position
	local key =
		bucketKey(math.floor(position.X / BUCKET_SIZE), math.floor(position.Z / BUCKET_SIZE))
	local base = position - Vector3.new(0, size.Y / 2, 0)
	if plant:IsA("BasePart") and plant:GetAttribute("CornGreenOriginal") == true then
		local offset = plant:GetAttribute("HarvestRootOffset")
		local templateSize = plant:GetAttribute("CornGreenTemplateSize")
		if
			typeof(offset) == "Vector3"
			and typeof(templateSize) == "Vector3"
			and templateSize.X > 0
			and templateSize.Y > 0
			and templateSize.Z > 0
		then
			base = frame:PointToWorldSpace(
				-Vector3.new(
					offset.X * size.X / templateSize.X,
					offset.Y * size.Y / templateSize.Y,
					offset.Z * size.Z / templateSize.Z
				)
			)
		end
	end
	local entry = {
		Layer = layer,
		Plant = plant,
		Parent = parent,
		Parts = parts,
		Position = position,
		Base = base,
		Bucket = key,
		Phase = (position.X * 0.17 + position.Z * 0.11) % (math.pi * 2),
		Moved = false,
	}
	layer.Entries[plant] = entry
	layer.Count += 1
	if not layer.Buckets[key] then
		layer.Buckets[key] = {}
	end
	layer.Buckets[key][entry] = true
	if layer.Kind == "near" then
		layer.Groups[parent].Entries[plant] = true
	end
	self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_indexBatch()
	local began, count = self._clock(), 0
	while
		self._pendingHead <= self._pendingTail
		and count < INDEX_BUDGET
		and self._clock() - began < INDEX_SECONDS
	do
		local job = self._pending[self._pendingHead]
		self._pending[self._pendingHead] = nil
		self._pendingHead += 1
		self:_register(job)
		count += 1
	end
	if self._pendingHead > self._pendingTail then
		self._pending, self._pendingHead, self._pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	end
end

function CornWindController:_removeGroup(layer: any, folder: Instance)
	local group = layer.Groups[folder]
	if not group then
		return
	end
	disconnect(group.Connections)
	for plant in group.Entries do
		self:_remove(layer, plant)
	end
	layer.Groups[folder] = nil
end

function CornWindController:_bindGroup(layer: any, folder: Instance)
	if
		layer.Groups[folder]
		or not folder:IsA("Folder")
		or folder.Parent ~= layer.Folder
		or not folder.Name:match("^Chunk_")
	then
		return
	end
	local group = { Connections = {}, Entries = {} }
	layer.Groups[folder] = group
	table.insert(
		group.Connections,
		folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(plant)
			self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		group.Connections,
		folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(plant)
			self:_remove(layer, plant)
		end)
	)
	for _, plant in folder:GetChildren() do
		self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
	end
end

function CornWindController:_detachLayer(kind: string)
	local layer = self._layers[kind]
	if not layer then
		return
	end
	for _, group in layer.Groups do
		disconnect(group.Connections)
	end
	disconnect(layer.Connections)
	for _, entry in layer.Entries do
		self:_restore(entry)
		self._active[entry] = nil
	end
	self._layers[kind] = nil
	self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
end

function CornWindController:_bindLayer(folder: Instance?, kind: string)
	local previous = self._layers[kind]
	if previous and previous.Folder == folder and self:_ownedLayer(previous.Folder, kind) then
		return
	end
	self:_detachLayer(kind)
	if not folder or not self:_ownedLayer(folder, kind) then
		return
	end
	local layer = {
		Kind = kind,
		Folder = folder,
		Connections = {},
		Entries = {},
		Buckets = {},
		Groups = {},
		Count = 0,
	}
	self._layers[kind] = layer
	table.insert(
		layer.Connections,
		folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(plant)
			if kind == "near" then
				self:_bindGroup(layer, plant)
			else
				self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
			end
		end)
	)
	table.insert(
		layer.Connections,
		folder.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(plant)
			if kind == "near" then
				self:_removeGroup(layer, plant)
			else
				self:_remove(layer, plant)
			end
		end)
	)
	for _, attribute in
		{
			"corn_project_id",
			if kind == "near" then "CornClientRendererOwned" else "CornClientBackdropOwned",
			"Ready",
		}
	do
		table.insert(
			layer.Connections,
			folder:GetAttributeChangedSignal(attribute):Connect(function()
				if not self:_ownedLayer(folder, kind) then
					self:_detachLayer(kind)
				elseif kind == "far" and folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true then
					folder:SetAttribute("CornWindAnimated", 0)
					for entry in self._active do
						if entry.Layer == layer then
							self:_restore(entry)
							self._active[entry] = nil
						end
					end
				end
				self._selectElapsed = SELECT_SEC
			end)
		)
	end
	for _, plant in folder:GetChildren() do
		if kind == "near" then
			self:_bindGroup(layer, plant)
		else
			self:_enqueue(layer, plant, folder)
		end
	end
end

function CornWindController:_clearMap()
	self._monsterSamples = {}
	self:_detachLayer("near")
	self:_detachLayer("far")
	disconnect(self._mapConnections)
	self._map = nil
	self._pending, self._pendingHead, self._pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	self:_restoreActive()
end

function CornWindController:_resolveMap()
	local map = Workspace:FindFirstChild("CornMap")
	if
		not map
		or not map:IsA("Model")
		or map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("Asmr_Base")
		or Workspace:FindFirstChild("ASMR_Models")
	then
		self:_clearMap()
		return
	end
	if map ~= self._map then
		self:_clearMap()
		self._map = map
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
				if self._map == map and map.Parent ~= Workspace then
					self:_clearMap()
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map:GetAttributeChangedSignal("corn_project_id"):Connect(function()
				if self._map == map and map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID then
					self:_clearMap()
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map.ChildAdded:Connect(function(item)
				if item.Name == "CornClientPlants" then
					self:_bindLayer(item, "near")
				elseif item.Name == "CornClientBackdrop" then
					self:_bindLayer(item, "far")
				end
			end)
		)
		table.insert(
			self._mapConnections,
			map.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(item)
				for kind, layer in self._layers do
					if layer.Folder == item then
						self:_detachLayer(kind)
					end
				end
			end)
		)
	end
	self:_bindLayer(map:FindFirstChild("CornClientPlants"), "near")
	self:_bindLayer(map:FindFirstChild("CornClientBackdrop"), "far")
end

local function horizontalDistanceSquared(a: Vector3, b: Vector3): number
	local delta = a - b
	return delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z
end

local function visible(entry: any, camera: Camera): boolean
	if
		horizontalDistanceSquared(entry.Position, camera.CFrame.Position)
		> MONSTER_VIEW_RADIUS ^ 2
	then
		return false
	end
	local shown = false
	for _, saved in entry.Parts do
		if saved.Part.Transparency < 0.99 and saved.Part.LocalTransparencyModifier < 0.99 then
			shown = true
			break
		end
	end
	if not shown then
		return false
	end
	local screen, onScreen = camera:WorldToViewportPoint(entry.Position)
	return onScreen and screen.Z > 0
end

function CornWindController:_actorCandidates(
	camera: Camera,
	position: Vector3,
	front: Vector3?,
	active: any
): { any }
	local result, scanned = {}, 0
	for _, kind in { "near", "far" } do
		local layer = self._layers[kind]
		if
			not layer
			or not self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, kind)
			or (kind == "far" and layer.Folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
		then
			continue
		end
		for x = math.floor((position.X - RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE), math.floor((position.X + RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE) do
			for z = math.floor((position.Z - RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE), math.floor((position.Z + RADIUS) / BUCKET_SIZE) do
				for entry in layer.Buckets[bucketKey(x, z)] or {} do
					scanned += 1
					if scanned > SCAN_LIMIT then
						break
					end
					local delta = entry.Position - position
					local distance = delta.X * delta.X + delta.Z * delta.Z
					local ahead = front == nil
						or distance <= 1.8 ^ 2
						or delta.X * front.X + delta.Z * front.Z >= 0
					if
						distance <= RADIUS ^ 2
						and ahead
						and not active[entry]
						and math.abs(position.Y - entry.Base.Y) <= 7
						and self:_validEntry(entry)
						and visible(entry, camera)
					then
						table.insert(result, { Entry = entry, Distance = distance })
					end
				end
				if scanned > SCAN_LIMIT then
					break
				end
			end
			if scanned > SCAN_LIMIT then
				break
			end
		end
		if scanned > SCAN_LIMIT then
			break
		end
	end
	self._lastScanned += math.min(scanned, SCAN_LIMIT)
	table.sort(result, function(a, b)
		return a.Distance < b.Distance
	end)
	local selected = {}
	for index = 1, math.min(ACTOR_LIMIT, #result) do
		table.insert(selected, result[index].Entry)
	end
	return selected
end

function CornWindController:_playerPosition(): Vector3?
	local character = self._player and self._player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		self._playerRoot, self._previousPlayer, self._playerTrail = nil, nil, 0
		return nil
	end
	if self._playerRoot ~= root then
		self:_restoreActive()
		self._playerRoot, self._previousPlayer, self._playerTrail = root, nil, 0
	end
	local position = root.Position
	if
		humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05
		or (
			self._previousPlayer
			and horizontalDistanceSquared(position, self._previousPlayer) > 0.01
		)
	then
		self._playerTrail = self._time + TRAIL_SEC
	end
	self._previousPlayer = position
	return if self._playerTrail > self._time then position else nil
end

function CornWindController:_monsterPosition(): Vector3?
	local runtime = self._map and self._map:FindFirstChild("CornRoundRuntime")
	local nearest, nearestRoot, distance = nil, nil, math.huge
	for index = 1, 3 do
		local monster = runtime
			and runtime:IsA("Folder")
			and runtime:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") == PROJECT_ID
			and runtime:FindFirstChild(if index == 1 then "Monster" else "Monster" .. index)
		local root = monster and monster:FindFirstChild("Root")
		local state = monster and monster:GetAttribute("HuntState")
		if
			not monster
			or not monster:IsA("Model")
			or monster:GetAttribute("CornMonsterOwned") ~= true
			or monster:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
			or monster:GetAttribute("MonsterRigVersion") ~= 1
			or monster:GetAttribute("MonsterIndex") ~= index
			or not root
			or not root:IsA("BasePart")
			or (state ~= "patrol" and state ~= "chase")
		then
			self._monsterSamples[index] = nil
			continue
		end
		local sample = self._monsterSamples[index]
		if not sample or sample.root ~= root then
			sample = { root = root, previous = root.Position, untilAt = 0 }
			self._monsterSamples[index] = sample
		end
		local position = root.Position
		if horizontalDistanceSquared(position, sample.previous) > 0.01 then
			sample.untilAt = self._time + TRAIL_SEC
		end
		sample.previous = position
		local candidate = if self._playerRoot
			then horizontalDistanceSquared(position, self._playerRoot.Position)
			else math.huge
		if sample.untilAt > self._time and candidate < distance then
			nearest, nearestRoot, distance = sample, root, candidate
		end
	end
	self._monsterRoot = nearestRoot
	self._previousMonster = if nearest then nearest.previous else nil
	self._monsterTrail = if nearest then nearest.untilAt else 0
	return if nearest then nearest.previous else nil
end

function CornWindController:_select(camera: Camera)
	local chosen, active = {}, {}
	self._lastScanned = 0
	local function add(position: Vector3?, front: Vector3?)
		if not position then
			return
		end
		for _, entry in self:_actorCandidates(camera, position, front, active) do
			active[entry] = true
			table.insert(chosen, entry)
		end
	end
	add(self:_playerPosition(), camera.CFrame.LookVector)
	if self._playerRoot then
		add(self:_monsterPosition(), nil)
	end
	for entry in self._active do
		if not active[entry] then
			self:_restore(entry)
		end
	end
	self._active, self._selected = active, chosen
end

function CornWindController:_diagnostics(near: number, far: number)
	for kind, layer in self._layers do
		if self:_ownedLayer(layer.Folder, kind) then
			local count = if kind == "near" then near else far
			if layer.Folder:GetAttribute("CornWindAnimated") ~= count then
				layer.Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindAnimated", count)
			end
			if layer.Folder:GetAttribute("CornWindMode") ~= (self._mode or "off") then
				layer.Folder:SetAttribute("CornWindMode", self._mode or "off")
			end
		end
	end
end

function CornWindController:_animate(camera: Camera)
	local writes, near, far = 0, 0, 0
	for _, entry in self._selected do
		if writes + #entry.Parts > PART_LIMIT then
			break
		end
		if
			not self._active[entry]
			or not self:_validEntry(entry)
			or (entry.Layer.Kind == "far" and entry.Layer.Folder:GetAttribute("Ready") ~= true)
			or not visible(entry, camera)
		then
			self:_restore(entry)
			continue
		end
		local phase = entry.Phase
		local x = ANGLE * 0.75 * math.sin(self._time * 7 + phase)
		local z = ANGLE * 0.35 * math.sin(self._time * 5 + phase * 1.4)
		local transform = CFrame.new(entry.Base) * CFrame.Angles(x, 0, z) * CFrame.new(-entry.Base)
		for _, saved in entry.Parts do
			saved.Part.CFrame = transform * saved.Frame
		end
		entry.Moved = true
		writes += #entry.Parts
		if entry.Layer.Kind == "near" then
			near += 1
		else
			far += 1
		end
	end
	self._lastWrites, self._lastNear, self._lastFar = writes, near, far
	self:_diagnostics(near, far)
end

function CornWindController:SetMode(mode: string?)
	local nextMode = if mode == "easy" or mode == "medium" or mode == "hard" then mode else nil
	if self._mode == nextMode then
		return
	end
	self:_restoreActive()
	self._mode = nextMode
	self._previousPlayer, self._previousMonster = nil, nil
	self._monsterSamples = {}
	self._playerTrail, self._monsterTrail = 0, 0
	self._updateElapsed, self._selectElapsed = UPDATE_SEC, SELECT_SEC
	self._lastWrites, self._lastNear, self._lastFar = 0, 0, 0
	self:_diagnostics(0, 0)
end

function CornWindController:_step(delta: number)
	self._time += math.clamp(delta, 0, 0.25)
	self._resolveElapsed += delta
	if self._resolveElapsed >= RESOLVE_SEC then
		self._resolveElapsed = 0
		self:_resolveMap()
	end
	self:_indexBatch()
	if not self._mode then
		return
	end
	self._updateElapsed += delta
	self._selectElapsed += delta
	if self._updateElapsed < UPDATE_SEC then
		return
	end
	self._updateElapsed = 0
	local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if
		not camera
		or not self._map
		or self._map.Parent ~= Workspace
		or self._map:GetAttribute("corn_project_id") ~= PROJECT_ID
	then
		self:_restoreActive()
		return
	end
	if self._selectElapsed >= SELECT_SEC then
		self._selectElapsed = 0
		self:_select(camera)
	end
	self:_animate(camera)
end

function CornWindController:Init(context: any)
	self._enabled = RunService:IsStudio()
		and context.Config.Environment == "DEV"
		and (
			context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "solo_local"
			or context.Config.Game.SessionMode == "team_local"
		)
	self._connection, self._player = nil, Players.LocalPlayer
	self._clock = os.clock
	self._map, self._mode = nil, nil
	self._layers, self._mapConnections, self._active, self._selected = {}, {}, {}, {}
	self._pending, self._pendingHead, self._pendingTail = {}, 1, 0
	self._time, self._resolveElapsed, self._updateElapsed, self._selectElapsed =
		0, RESOLVE_SEC, UPDATE_SEC, SELECT_SEC
	self._lastWrites, self._lastNear, self._lastFar, self._lastScanned = 0, 0, 0, 0
	self._previousPlayer, self._previousMonster, self._playerRoot, self._monsterRoot =
		nil, nil, nil, nil
	self._playerTrail, self._monsterTrail = 0, 0
	self._monsterSamples = {}
end

function CornWindController:Start()
	if not self._enabled or self._connection then
		return
	end
	self:_resolveMap()
	self._connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(delta)
		self:_step(delta)
	end)
end

function CornWindController:Destroy()
	self:SetMode(nil)
	self._enabled = false
	if self._connection then
		self._connection:Disconnect()
		self._connection = nil
	end
	self:_clearMap()
end

return CornWindController

	{ CollisionFidelity = Enum.CollisionFidelity.Box, RenderFidelity = Enum.RenderFidelity.Precise }

	assert(type(value) == "table" and #value == 3, "Corn Vector3 triple required")
	for _, n in value do
		assert(
			type(n) == "number" and n == n and math.abs(n) < math.huge,
			"Finite corn channel required"
		)
	end
	return Vector3.new(value[1], value[2], value[3])

	assert(KEYS[key] == true, "Unknown authored green corn shape")

		script.Parent:FindFirstChild("CornGreenGeometryData"),
		"Corn geometry data folder missing"
	)
	local source = assert(folder:FindFirstChild(key), "Corn shape data missing")
	assert(source:IsA("ModuleScript"), "Corn shape data must be a ModuleScript")
	local data = require(source)
	assert(
		type(data) == "table" and data.key == key and data.height_studs == 8,
		"Exact 8-stud corn data required"
	)
	assert(data.texture_uri == "rbxassetid://137803536172445", "Green corn palette required")
	assert(
		type(data.exported_fbx_sha256) == "string"
			and #data.exported_fbx_sha256 == 64
			and data.exported_fbx_sha256:match("^[a-f0-9]+$") ~= nil,
		"Exported FBX hash required"
	)
	assert(#data.positions == 377 and #data.triangles == 510, "Authored corn topology changed")
	assert(
		#data.uvs > 0 and #data.uvs <= 2000 and #data.normals > 0 and #data.normals <= 2000,
		"Bounded corn corner channels required"
	)
	assert(
		#data.triangle_uvs == 510 and #data.triangle_normals == 510,
		"Complete corn corner channels required"
	)

		return descriptions[key]
	end

	local offset = vector(data.bbox_center_from_root_studs)
	assert(
		size.Y == 8 and size.X > 0 and size.X < 6 and size.Z > 0 and size.Z < 6,
		"Bounded corn dimensions required"

	assert(
		(offset + vector(data.root_offset_studs)).Magnitude < 0.00001
			and math.abs(offset.Y - 4) < 0.00001,
		"Exact corn root anchor required"
	)

		size = size,
		rootOffset = offset,
		sourceHash = data.exported_fbx_sha256,
		sourceName = data.name,
		key = key,
